is_aqir.name: Aqir
is_aqir.description:
Species Trait: Infection

Active when there are at least (N) different Aqir chess pieces on the chessboard. (Multiple effects stack)

(2) Aqirs: Grants all non-Aqir allies: Upon death, if there is any Infected friendly piece of the same name on the chessboard, immediately hatches a random Aqir piece.
(4) Aqirs: Rank 1 effect now also applies to all friendly Aqir pieces , and will hatch a random higher-level Aqir piece.
is_aqir.lore: From time to time, the Aqirs dwelled on and beneath the ancient land of Drodo Island. Though most of their powers are sealed by the holy Gods, remained powers from the insanity within the Aqir blood draws their insectoid instinct to reside on the flesh of other creatures.
notes: Aqirs do not infect on chess pieces with a expiration duration.

The higher the level of the infected friendly chess piece, the higher the level of the summoned Aqir piece.Rank 1 effect summons the same-level piece as the dying chess piece. Rank 2 summons a chess piece that can be 1 level higher than the dying chess piece, randomly.

tiers.description: (4) Aqirs: Rank 1 effect now also applies to all friendly Aqir pieces , and will hatch a random higher-level Aqir piece.

is_assassin.name: Assassin
is_assassin.description:
The first movement of Assassin pieces in each round causes Assassins to leap over to the back of the enemy lineup. The first blow after Backstab Leap is always a critical strike with a random bonus damage amplifier.

Class Perk: Coup de Grace

Active when you have at least (N) different Assassin pieces on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(3) Assassins: All friendly assassins have 15%% chance to critical hit for 300%% damage.
(6) Assassins: All assassins have 15%% chance to critical hit for 400%% damage.
(9) Assassins: All assassins gain a Backstab Leap move after killing an enemy. This Backstab Leap always deals the maximum possible critical damage.
is_assassin.lore: Assassins are skilled executioners that leap into enemy backlines. Together, they gain a keen eye for weaknesses in enemy armor, gaining the ability to deliver devastating critical hits.

tiers.description: (6) Assassins: All assassins have 15%% chance to critical hit for 400%% damage.

SPECIES TRAIT: Stampede

Active when you have at least (N) different pieces of this species on board. (Multiple effects stack).

(2)Centaurs: All friendly Centaurs gain the effect: when starting a battle, immediately charge to the target grid with the most enemy pieces around, and stun the enemy pieces on the path.

is_draenei.name: Draenei
is_draenei.description:
SPECIES TRAIT: Blessing of the Naaru

Active when you have at least (N) different pieces of this species on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(2) Draeneis: All friendly Draenei gain the effect: Every 5 seconds, steal 50+2% max health from the nearest enemy chess piece to heal themselves.
(4) Draeneis: All friendly pieces gain effects: Whenever a cumulative total of more than 100 points of healing is taken it is split (cumulative healing) points of pure damage among the surrounding enemies.
is_draenei.lore: To evade the Burning Legions clutches, a congregation led by the Farseer fled their homelands, faithful to the Naaru and the Holy Light. They named themselves Draenei, the Exiled Ones.
notes: The blessings will not trigger for a while if there are no enemies in range.
The blessings have a single damage limit of 300 and a cooldown of 5 seconds.

SPECIES TRAIT: Divided we stand

Active when you have at least (N) different Naga pieces on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(2) Kobolds: Each two paired ally pieces on board will summon a replica when battle starts.

is_kobold.lore: Aggressive, xenophobic, yet industrious small humanoid creatures living in tunnels and caves deep below the surface. Known for not particularly intelligent, notoriously cowardly and individually weak, the dimunitive beings possess great potential in group combats. A candle on top of the head distinguishes the Kobolds.
notes: Due to the specialities of the species, Kobold will not benefit from Auto Combine on Bench.

Active when you have at least (N) different Monk pieces on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(2) Monks: All friendly melee Monks have a chance on dealing damage to instantly eliminate the target enemy with a low health.
(4) Monks: All friendly Monks have a chance on dealing damage to reduce the current health of the target enemy by half.
is_monk.lore: When the Pandaren were subjugated centuries ago, it was the monks that brought hope to a seemingly dim future. When the opportunity for revolution struck, they were well-trained to throw off the yoke of oppression.
notes: The more damage the Monk deals, the higher the probability that Drunken Stagger will trigger.

The victims were raised as Undeads with cruelty, turned into minions of the fleshless legion, and were forced to destroy their own kingdom under the command of the Fallen Prince.

is_wizard.name: Wizard
is_wizard.description:
Wizard chess pieces are never considered priority targets by enemies.

Class Perk: Something from Nothing

Active when you have at least (N) different Wizard pieces on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(2) Wizards: During the combat round, reduce the required number of chess pieces for the activation of race/class skills by 1, if there are (4) or more chess pieces needed.
(4) Wizards: If you trigger the unique non-Wizard race/class skill during the combat round, unlock all of its layers.
is_wizard.lore: Wizards play an ancient yet mysterious role. Even though they mostly comprehend oracles and do minor entertaining tricks, Wizards are regarded as evil by many others because of the uncertainty of their purpose of action. The unique power Wizards possess awakes the inner potential of others, leading to a more united alliance.
